description: This file implements the RandomData interface for generating various types of random data, including uniformly distributed, normal, exponential, gamma, and other distributions, as well as methods for generating secure random strings. The class manages both pseudo-random and cryptographically secure random number generators, supports reseeding, and provides utilities for random permutation and sampling.

classes.name: RandomDataGenerator
classes.description: Implementation of the RandomData interface providing methods to generate various random data types using underlying pseudo-random and secure random generators, with support for reseeding and cryptographic algorithms.

methods.name: nextHexString
methods.description: Generates a random hexadecimal string of specified length using the underlying pseudo-random generator.

methods.name: nextInt
methods.description: Returns a uniformly distributed random integer within the specified range.

methods.name: nextLong
methods.description: Returns a uniformly distributed random long within the specified range.

methods.name: nextSecureHexString
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure hexadecimal string of specified length.

methods.name: nextSecureInt
methods.description: Returns a cryptographically secure random integer within the specified range.

methods.name: nextSecureLong
methods.description: Returns a cryptographically secure random long within the specified range.

methods.name: nextPoisson
methods.description: Samples a Poisson-distributed random number with specified mean.

methods.name: nextGaussian
methods.description: Returns a normally distributed random number with specified mean and standard deviation.

methods.name: nextExponential
methods.description: Samples an exponentially distributed random number with specified mean.

methods.name: nextGamma
methods.description: Samples a gamma-distributed random value with specified shape and scale.

methods.name: nextHypergeometric
methods.description: Samples a hypergeometric-distributed random number.

methods.name: nextPascal
methods.description: Samples a Pascal (Negative Binomial) distributed random number.

methods.name: nextT
methods.description: Samples from a Student's t distribution with specified degrees of freedom.

methods.name: nextWeibull
methods.description: Samples from a Weibull distribution.

methods.name: nextZipf
methods.description: Samples from a Zipf distribution.

methods.name: nextBeta
methods.description: Samples from a Beta distribution.

methods.name: nextBinomial
methods.description: Samples from a Binomial distribution.

methods.name: nextCauchy
methods.description: Samples from a Cauchy distribution.

methods.name: nextChiSquare
methods.description: Samples from a Chi-Squared distribution.

methods.name: nextF
methods.description: Samples from an F distribution.

methods.name: nextUniform
methods.description: Returns a uniformly distributed double in [lower, upper], exclusive endpoints if specified.

methods.name: nextPermutation
methods.description: Returns a random permutation of integers as a subset of size k from [0, n-1].

methods.name: nextSample
methods.description: Returns a random sample of size k from the given collection.

methods.name: reSeed
methods.description: Reseeds the private pseudo-random generator with a given seed.

methods.name: reSeedSecure
methods.description: Reseeds the secure random generator, optionally with a specified seed.

methods.name: setSecureAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the algorithm and provider for the secure random generator using Java Security API.
